**Bridges and Straits are on the map again.** Each one shows its marker (open or closed icon); point at it or click it to read whether it is open or closed. A closed Bridge or Strait joins nothing, so no front line is drawn between the cities at its ends. The state comes from the war's own list, then from dynmap when the war is live, then from the map. Needs the site's new territories.json (it now carries the positions). (For Minecraft 1.21.11.)
